title: heygen-com/hyperframes
description_en: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

title: Harness by Autonomous
description_en: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.. Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.
description_zh: Harness解决了开发者需要在多个coding agent之间切换的痛点。产品是一个开源的命令中心,允许用户在同一界面管理工作中的Claude Code、家里的Codex、云端的Hermes等多个AI编程助手。支持原生桌面应用、终端命令行(hn)以及iOS/Android移动端,移动端支持语音交互回复agent。所有通信端到端加密保障安全。产品还扩展到代码之外的49个harness场景,包括CAD设计、电路、机器人、游戏和音乐创作。目前在Mac和Linux上免费提供。Product Hunt获得217票显示有一定社区认可度,开源策略有助于开发者采用。

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角:这是一个典型的'agent编排层'机会,市场正从单一agent走向multi-agent协作时代。Alpha在于:①抓住了开发者真实痛点(agent碎片化)②开源+跨平台策略可快速建立生态③端到端加密切中企业安全需求④49个harness扩展显示团队对垂直场景的理解。风险:①商业模式不清晰,开源项目变现困难②LangChain/AutoGPT等已有类似定位③需要持续维护多agent适配成本高④Autonomous团队此前做硬件,软件基因待验证。投资论文适配度中等:符合我们对agent基础设施的关注,但需要看到明确的企业客户和付费意愿才能进一步跟进。建议观察GitHub

title: GLM-Legal
description_en: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance. LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

title: Pomerado
description_en: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use. Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

description_en: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents. withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

description_en: A password manager for AI. GBrain Tools is a password manager for AI. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe, Notion and many more once, then use them from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or your terminal. No AI holds a password, and every action lands on one log. $19 a month.

title: Skisso
description_en: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff. Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. full_profile.biz_model_zh: 采用Freemium模式，基础功能免费使用。收费逻辑可能基于：①高级AI功能订阅 ②多渠道集成数量 ③团队席位数 ④API调用量。用户付费动机在于统一管理多个社交媒体客服渠道的刚需，以及MCP协议带来的AI灵活性（可自选最适合业务的AI模型）。与Intercom/Zendesk等传统客服平台相比，差异在于AI-first设计和MCP开放生态；与纯AI客服如Ada相比，优势是用户可自主选择AI供应商而非被锁定
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：①MCP协议是Anthropic推动的新标准，这是押注协议层的早期机会，类似早期押注OpenAI API生态 ②客服SaaS是成熟赛道（$20B+市场），但AI原生重构刚开始，传统玩家转型慢 ③风险：MCP生态尚未成熟，客服场景可能不是MCP最佳应用（相比coding/research）；Intercom等巨头快速AI化会挤压空间 ④投资论文适配度中等：符合AI Native工具方向，但客服赛道竞争激烈，需要看到明确的数据飞轮（客服对话→模型微调→更好回复）才能证明真正壁垒
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得16分：产品设计围绕MCP协议，支持多AI模型接入体现AI-first思维，但核心仍是传统客服平台加AI能力，未见用户对话数据反哺模型训练的闭环证据。Niche得12分：MCP协议集成是技术亮点但应用场景通用，客服SaaS赛道拥挤，差异化主要在协议选择而非场景深度。商业模式得14分：Freemium+订阅逻辑清晰，客服工具有明确付费意愿，但面临Intercom/Zendesk/Freshdesk等成熟竞品。团队得8分：创始人Tomer Aharon信息极少，无法确认AI背景或domain expertise，这是重大减分项。加分11分：MCP生态早期参与者+3，多渠道集成（WhatsApp/IG/FB）显示执行力+2，PH 5.0评分+2，已有付费用户（freemium模式暗示）+4。减分-3：创始人背景信息严重不足

title: Fish Audio Drama 3
description_en: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate. Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. title: Actually Asked
description_en: A self-improving branded AI FAQ page. Actually Asked puts a FAQ section on your site, in your fonts and colours, not a chat bubble. Visitors ask their own question or highlight a sentence to ask about it. Answers come only from your pages, and the questions asked most join your FAQ.
description_zh: Actually Asked是一个嵌入式AI FAQ解决方案，与传统聊天气泡不同，它以品牌化页面形式（使用网站字体和配色）集成到客户网站。核心机制：①访客可以直接提问或高亮网页句子询问详情 ②AI仅从客户自有页面内容中提取答案，确保准确性 ③系统追踪最常被问的问题，自动将其添加到FAQ列表，形成自我优化循环。目标用户是电商和需要客户支持的B2C网站。产品刚在Product Hunt发布，获得85票，属于低人气产品，暂无用户数据、收入数据或GitHub开源信息。这是一个典型的AI赋能传统FAQ的工具型产品。

title: The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock
description_en: arXiv:2610.20665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can solve complex interactive tasks, yet reasoning and tool calls take time. In continuously changing environments, an otherwise correct action may arrive too late. We introduce RealtimeBench, with 180 tasks across six game types, to evaluate agents while games continue running during inference. Paired evaluations show that GPT-6.1-sol outperforms the faster Jev when games are paused, but falls behind when they keep running. We propose Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement (TORSI): a slow teacher studies failures and tests corrections in paused games between attempts, then writes reusable instructions for a fast student. The student acts without teacher calls during gameplay, and validation scores
description_zh: 这是一篇arXiv学术论文，提出RealtimeBench基准测试集（180个任务，6种游戏类型），专门评估Agent在持续变化环境中的表现。核心发现是：当游戏暂停时GPT-6.1-sol优于更快的Jev模型，但在实时运行时反而落后，揭示了推理速度与准确性的权衡困境。论文提出TORSI（Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement）方法：慢速教师模型在暂停状态下分析失败案例并测试修正方案，生成可复用指令；快速学生模型在实际游戏中执行，无需调用教师模型。这是针对实时决策场景的Agent训练新范式，但目前仅停留在学术研究阶段，无产品形态或商业化计划。

description_en: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data. title: Talanoa
description_en: Email that feels like chat. Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

title: Jockey by TwelveLabs
description_en: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood. Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

title: Navige
description_en: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending. Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

title: SignWith
description_en: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.. Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

title: siliXon
description_en: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order. Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

title: Kerno 1.0
description_en: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer. Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

title: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
description_en: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents. Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps without touching your local setup. Each Sandbox has a persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL. Create one per task, branch, or PR, then let your agents manage it through MCP, CLI, SDK, or API.

title: SuperLocalMemory
description_en: Agent memory with Laya, Jev + Google Gemma. The relaunch of SuperLocalMemory, rebuilt from the ground up and backed by four arXiv papers. One local-first memory brain for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP or CLI agent. It never bluffs: recall says supported, related or no answer, checked by Laya on your Mac or Jev online. Find pictures and PDFs by describing them, with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2. Governed, mesh-connected, AGPL-3.0. Built by Qualixar, the AI Reliability Engineering lab behind 10 open-source products.

title: Afterparty
description_en: Automated actions for meeting deliverables. Note takers give you a list. Afterparty does the list. Paste a transcript or connect your note taker, and agents draft every email, message, invite and CRM note in the right app, with context from your tools. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

title: Shrine
description_en: A home for your agents. Shrine lives in your Mac's notch. A glance shows how many Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions are working and which one needs you, so there is no dashboard window to keep open. Each push, pull request and research session earns a piece of pixel art for a small room that fills up as you work. Find the joy in your agents work.

title: CmdRound
description_en: Assess how engineers build with artificial intelligence. CmdRound is an assessment platform for hiring managers. You send a candidate a link and they get 55 minutes with Claude Code to implement industry-standard work in a real codebase. Each task is tailor-made to measure how good a candidate is at combining their engineering skills with agents. At the end of the assessment you get a score on four plain questions and a replay of every call they made. Scoring is rule-based, with no LLM judge. $49 for 10 candidates, one-time, lasts a year.

title: Audimate
description_en: AI assistant that works right in the apps you already use. Meet Arro, the AI assistant that does the busywork. Arro works right in the apps you already use. Point at something and ask, and it shows you each step on your screen or does the work for you. Show it a task once and it writes a playbook you can read and edit, then repeats it whenever you ask or on a schedule. Ready to use out of the box. No technical setup required. Free for Windows and Mac.

title: Rushilo
description_en: Edit video by talking to Claude Code or Codex. Rushilo is a Mac and Windows video editor that your own AI drives. Connect Claude Code or Codex, select a clip, and say the edit: trim, split, caption, cut filler words, resize, export. Every change lands on a visible timeline you can undo. Screen recording with auto zoom on Mac, on-device Whisper captions, and direct YouTube upload. We ship no AI, so there are no credits: your subscription or keys pay. Files stay on your disk. $99 once, 3 computers.

title: Lleverage
description_en: The autonomous back office for the physical economy. Lleverage runs the back office of manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors with AI agents. They read orders, invoices and purchase orders from email and PDF, check them against the ERP (SAP, Business Central, Exact, NetSuite and more) and post the clean ones. People only handle the exceptions, with approvals and a full audit trail. No migration: the ERP stays the system of record. EU hosted.

title: Lovable Growth Tools
description_en: From building your app to growing it, in one chat. Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.

title: BOSS Console
description_en:
A tiny OS for your always-on agents. BOSS Console is a tiny OS for your always-on agents. Create your own agent with real tools, chat at fluck.ai, and access live sessions at cli.risaboss.com.

title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
description_en: NVIDIA’s open multimodal model for specialized agents. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA’s open, customizable multimodal model for specialized agents.
